description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'BaseReferenceRange' which serves as a base for reference range entities in the OpenMRS system. It includes fields for high and low absolute, critical, and normal reference values, along with their respective getter and setter methods. The class is annotated as a mapped superclass with auditing features, indicating it is intended for inheritance by other entity classes.

classes.name: BaseReferenceRange
classes.description: An abstract base class for managing reference range data with annotated persistence fields for high and low reference thresholds.
